records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Subscription revenue increased by $54.6 million during the three months ended October 31, 2025, compared to the same period a year ago, primarily due to the impact of cloud transition agreements entered into and provisioned since October 31, 2024, new subscription agreements, and the renewal or extension of subscription services at the fully ramped annual fees after the initial committed term.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We have experienced seasonal variations in our license revenue and, to a lesser extent, in our subscription revenue as a result of increased customer orders in our fourth fiscal quarter, which is the quarter ending July 31.
